concept: IAM: protecting the root user (MFA, no access keys)
tests: Knowing best practices for handling the account root user.
expected: Enable MFA on root, delete root access keys, do daily work through IAM roles/users with least privilege; root only for rare tasks. Triggers: "root user", "least privilege", "after setting up the account".
why_not: Using root for daily work violates least privilege; root access keys (even in Secrets Manager) are dangerous long-lived credentials; the root user cannot be deleted.
